text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey under pressure to oust U.S. and British warplanes policing a no-fly zone in northern Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-JUMHOURIYA and AL-THAWRA)
- Commentary lashes out at U.S. for attitude on latest incursion by Turkish troops into northern Iraq.
- Health ministry tightens inspection of pharmacies in Baghdad.
- Iraqi company manufactures new batch of computers.
- Egyptian security organs unveil attempt to kill Mubarak.
- Commentary slams Iran for holding Iraqi prisoners from the 1980-1988 Gulf War.
- Iraq will soon provide evidence that it has no more banned ballistic missiles in its arsenal.
